source_evidence: While the market price of a publicly traded REIT is readily accessible, it can be difficult to determine the value of a share of a non-traded REIT.
question: Misconception: All REITs trade on stock exchanges, so their shares can be readily sold and their prices are easy to check.
answer: Not all REITs are publicly traded. Publicly traded REITs trade on a stock exchange, while non-traded REITs do not. The source explains that non-traded REIT shares may be harder to value, and generally cannot be sold readily on the open market—so exchange trading and easy resale should not be assumed for every REIT.
